title: Rotgut's WMDs II

html:
Quest Giver: TownCommander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Z'lash in Z'lash's Pad off of Upper Mutanous Malaise, Level 1, and report to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: TownCommander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Rotgut's WMDs II

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Z'lash in Z'lash's Pad off of Upper Mutanous Malaise, Level 1, and report to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Mutanous Melee. Does that name ring a bell? It was Rotgut's first and most prominent band and their unique brand of speed metal was a huge success, spawning literally hundreds of tribute creature bands. In fact, they were the first band to consist of six guitarists.

They got so huge that there was some serious concerns that they would be able to mobilize their following to overthrow the Kingdom. Then, just as fast as they had risen, they fell apart. There are all kinds of rumors as to why they broke up and there was even a travelling theatre troupe that would perform a play based on these rumors called 'Mutanous Melee: Behind the Speed Metal.' It was a train wreck and therefore insanely popular.

Ever since Mutanous Melee broke up, there hasn't been a creature band popular enough to threaten the Kingdom, but that has all changed. We now know that Rotgut is not harboring any WMDs, but it turns out that he is going to try and unite all the original members of Mutanous Melee under the new band name, Wastoid Mutant Deathmarch. I don't need to tell you that this bit of news has the King's Board of Trustees rocking back and forth in their thrones drooling from the mouth and muttering long repressed Mutanous Melee lyrics.

This all leads me up to why I've asked for your help. We need you to go and take out one of Rotgut's Mutanous Melee guitarists; Z'lash. You can find him off of Mutanous Melee, Level 1, in Z'lash's Pad. Once you have taken care of Z'lash, report to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine. Good luck!

Turn-in:

Glad to see you reporting for duty, Dungeon Runner. Ooh, I just said duty. Heh heh. Sorry, that wasn't very professionalistic of me. By your presence here I assume that you have made quick work of Z'lash. Well done.

Objectives:

  • Slay Z'lash

Client level range: 35–50
